chain_words.nuance: outward courteous behaviour, often a matter of manners
considerate treatment of others in everyday interaction
general warmth and concern for the wellbeing of others
willingness to give time, money, or attention to others
deep and sustained goodwill towards all people

explanation: These words all describe positive treatment of others, from outward good manners to a deep and lasting goodwill towards people.

usage_notes.difference: 'Kindness' describes warmth shown to particular people in particular situations; 'benevolence' describes a more general and lasting goodwill towards humanity.
